route_evidence.ordered_route: Kanonia square, Jezuicka, Celna, Gnojna Góra lookout, Brzozowa, Kamienne Schodki steps, Celna, Jezuicka
route_evidence.turns_topology: Walk straight along Kanonia/Jezuicka, turn right into Celna, pass under the arch to Gnojna Góra, turn left at the lookout, continue onto Brzozowa, make a sharp right-turn loop to overlook the river view, then turn left/backwards onto Brzozowa, go straight up to Celna/Kamienne Schodki, and turn right back onto Jezuicka.
route_evidence.uncertainty: The exact transition around Kamienne Schodki and the final stretch on Jezuicka are dimly lit, but the landmarks are highly distinct.
